> Tested locally on the MRP as well as the [Material Testers demo](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects/tree/master/3d/material_testers) with the real-time sky update mode, it works as expected.
> 
> However, I'm not 100% sure it's the right solution to the problem. This leads to a slightly different appearance when using 8 roughness layers. This is the default value in the project settings, which produces a warning when using the real-time sky update mode as 7 is preferred instead
>

Thanks for the feedback! Do you mean this PR wrongly makes 7 and 8 layers look the same? Because the After look the same but the Before differ.

> Do you mean this PR wrongly makes 7 and 8 layers look the same? Because the After look the same but the Before differ.

Yes, I think they're meant to look different (hence the warning on startup).

> > Do you mean this PR wrongly makes 7 and 8 layers look the same? Because the After look the same but the Before differ.
> 
> Yes, I think they're meant to look different (hence the warning on startup).

4.6.1 and 4.5.2 still make them look similar on my side. What version did u test against?

However it makes sense to me I think. Please correct me if I'm wrong. I think adding more layers only increase the number of layers used in radiance maps but don't necessarily cause visible changes jumping from 7 to 8.

> 4.6.1 and 4.5.2 still make them look similar on my side. What version did u test against?
